procedure.row_numbering: One-based physical lines in the separately named original or amended label file; never treat amended row numbers as original row identities.
procedure.delta_direction: amended minus original; a reference effect, not a model improvement
procedure.both_corner_denominator: Every object with two locatable reference corners, including misses; recomputed separately for each reference.
procedure.zero_denominator: null; a delta involving null is omitted
procedure.geometry_epsilon_purpose: Serialization arithmetic only; not annotation accuracy.

verification.method: Separate normalized-label parser, direct area IoU, confidence-ordered one-to-one greedy matching and endpoint/radius calculation; did not import production scoring functions.

limits: Development validation already used for model selection; this is not an independent test.
Amended-label effects must not be attributed to new training or rewritten into historical benchmark results.
Coordinate radii are measured in original image pixels; no physical-unit guarantee follows.
Geometry checks establish file consistency, not correctness of visual annotation judgments.
